title: AgentShield SECURITY_POLICY.json
description: Guardrail policy exported by AgentShield (https://abtx2323.github.io/agent-shield/). Prompt-level rings (L1-L3) reduce risk; L4-L6 must be enforced by the agent runtime or MCP gateway, not by the model.

profile.description: AgentShield target profile the policy was exported from.

activeDefenseRings.description: Guardrail rings that were enabled at export time.

xmlUntrustedSandboxing.description: L1: wrap emails, web pages, RAG chunks and tool output in <untrusted_context> and treat them as data, never instructions.

stripInvisibleUnicode.description: L2: remove Unicode format characters (\p{Cf}: Plane-14 tags, zero-width, bidi controls) and variation selectors before tokenization, and flag inputs that contained them.

recursiveBase64Inspect.description: L2: decode Base64/hex/URL-encoded segments before running injection heuristics.

enforcePrivilegeHierarchy.description: L3: system > verified user > tool/RAG output.

maxToolRetriesPerTurn.description: L3 circuit breaker. null means no cap (unsafe).

maxTokenBudgetPerTurn.description: L3 token budget per turn. null means no budget (unsafe).

pinToolDescriptionSha256.description: L4: reject MCP tools whose description no longer matches its pinned SHA-256.

resolveSymlinksBeforePathCheck.description: L4: canonicalize paths (realpath) before checking them against allowedFilePaths.

allowedFilePaths.description: L4: path globs file tools may touch. ["/*"] means unrestricted (unsafe).

denyFilePatterns.description: L4: paths that are always refused, even inside allowedFilePaths.

requireHitlForTools.description: L5: tools that need explicit human approval before every call.

stripExternalImages.description: L6: drop external images in model output: inline Markdown, reference-style Markdown and raw tags.

allowedDomains.description: L6: exact hostnames outbound requests and images may reach. ["*"] means any host (unsafe).

enforcementNote.description: Human-readable reminder of where the policy has to be enforced.
